SHERIFF•CORONER•MARSHAL
Carrying Concealed Weapon
Requirements & Approved Instructors
The following Firearms Safety and Qualification Course Instructors are recognized and approved
by the Imperial County Sheriff’s Office. The applicant may select one of the following instructors
to complete the state-mandated firearms safety and qualification course. The applicant will need
to contact the instructor to schedule an appointment. All fees listed below are set by the
instructors; therefore the Imperial County Sheriff’s Office is not responsible for any fees charged
or changed by the instructor.
The applicant must complete the following before the CCW License can be issued:
1. Application submitted on https://imperialca.permitium.com/ccw/start.
2. Once approved, schedule an appointment with one of the following approved instructors
and successfully complete the state-mandated firearms safety course and range
qualification.
a. Applicant must qualify with the firearms listed on their CCW application (max 3
firearms).
3. Upload current (issued within 90 days of approval) Imperial County Sheriff’s Office “CCW
Applicant’s - Firearm Inspection, Shooting Proficiency, and Training Course Completion
Certification” to https://imperialca.permitium.com/ccw/start order tracker.
4. Submit payment of all required fees.
The applicant will be notified by email when their CCW License is ready for issuance and for further
instruction to schedule an appointment for pick-up from the Imperial County Sheriff’s Office,
Records Division. For any questions, you may contact the Records Division at 442-265-2125 or
recordsdivision@icso.org.
